text: Aurelia demo (src/aurelia-demo): Vite cannot resolve paths under a '#' root, so vite.config.ts carries a pre-resolution plugin for relative ids, an alias to the built @authkit/aurelia2 entry, and CSS lives in public/ behind a <link>; the file: dependency needs ../../../AuthKit.Aurelia (three levels), not the brief's ../../.

Aurelia demo models Cl@ve as one provider (demo/clave) with three methods, matching ClaveMethods.cs; UI renders descriptors only. beginFederation is positional (providerRef, level, method, returnUrl) and Aurelia 2 rc.2 has no .one-way binding command (AUR0009).
